subject: Proposal: OrinTech annual renewal + mid-year top-up
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@orintech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: OrinTech annual renewal + mid-year top-up

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time this morning. As discussed, OrinTech is approaching your October renewal window and you’ve had higher-than-forecast usage over the last two quarters. I pulled together two concise options so we can find a path that fits your budget and preserves low latency for the customer-facing features.

Quick summary (high level):
- Option A — Annual renewal (co-term to Oct 31): keep current commit, add a 20% mid-year top-up bucket to absorb the recent burst; 5% loyalty discount on the renewal term.
- Option B — Commit conversion (retainer-style): convert current overages into a smaller, pre-paid retainer that smooths monthly spend; includes a usage smoothing credit (applied as invoice credit) and 10% discount on top-up units if you commit for 12 months.

Action items for us to price precisely:
1) Confirmation of current monthly token throughput (if you can share last 90 days CSV).
2) Procurement timeline (PO lead time, any vendor onboarding docs).
3) Preference for co-term vs. retainer-conversion model.

I’m looping in Jordan for CS context; Jordan — can you confirm whether the KV cache optimization pilot is on track? If that goes well it reduces the effective top-up needed by ~15%.

I’ll follow up with a brief pricing attachment and two one-page option sheets by end of day Friday.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 1) placeholder: pricing one-pager (to follow)
From: Alice Park <alice@orintech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: OrinTech Procurement <procurement@orintech.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: OrinTech annual renewal + mid-year top-up

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the call and the clear options. A few clarifications from our side before you finalize numbers:

- Budget constraint: our FY27 budget for LLM infra is effectively flat; any renewal needs to be neutral-to-savings year-over-year unless we can justify ROI to finance.
- We’re open to a retainer-style model if it reduces monthly variability, but the CFO will require a clear mapping from retainer to expected tokens/month.
- Priority: keep latency for our customer chat product under 220ms 95th. If the caching pilot reduces top-up needs, that will be important input.

Procurement timeline: we typically have a 2–3 week PO cycle once terms are agreed. Legal will need standard DP/SEC clauses (SOC2 attestation and data residency confirmation).

Can you include a version of Option B that shows a mid-year true-up (6 months) and one that amortizes over 12 months? Also please call out any one-time migration/implementation fees (we want to avoid surprises).

Appreciate it — I’ll follow up with the usage export to help you size the proposal.

— Alice
Alice Park
Head of Platform Engineering | OrinTech
alice@orintech.com | +1 (617) 555-0109

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice@orintech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, OrinTech Procurement <procurement@orintech.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: OrinTech annual renewal + mid-year top-up

Alice / team —

Appreciate the context. Per your ask, attached are two concrete option sheets plus the detailed pricing workbook. Highlights and clarifications below.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- OrinTech_pricing_v3.pdf — one-page summary of two options and breakers
- 2026_quarterly_pricing_table.xlsx — workbook with token tiers, XS/ S/ M/ L buckets, and amortization scenarios

Short option detail: 
Option 1 — Co-term + mid-year buffer (recommended if procurement prefers a single PO):
- Add a 25% buffer bucket to cover the last two quarters’ excess usage; buffer priced at a 6% uplift from list.
- Renewal discount: 6% on the renewed commit (one-year term).
- No implementation fee.

Option 2 — Retainer / commit-conversion (recommended if you want predictable monthly burn):
- Convert excess monthly overages into a $120k retainer that buys a guaranteed monthly throughput (token allocation shown in sheet).
- Apply a 10% top-up discount on additional blocks purchased against the retainer for 12 months.
- Two variants in sheet: 6-month true-up (higher monthly amortization) and 12-month amortization (lower monthlies).
- One-time onboarding/engineering support (optional): $8k if you want Redwood to run the cache tuning pilot (includes 4 weeks of eng time). If you manage the pilot, no fee.

Terms & compliance: SOC 2 Type II attestation is available and we will include a data residency confirmation in the contract appendix. Standard SOW/DP language is fine; I’ve flagged the DocuSign link in related_links for faster exec.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send the last 90 days usage export (CSV) — I’ve used the high-level numbers you shared but want the exacts to finalize token counts.
2) Confirm preferred option variant (co-term buffer vs. retainer w/ 6- or 12-month amortization).
3) If you pick retainer, confirm whether Redwood should do the cache tuning pilot (I’ll provision a small engineer allocation and an SOW).

If this looks directionally good, Monica will prepare the commercial summary and draft order form for review. Monica — can you prepare an initial OF that includes both co-term and retainer line items so OrinTech can choose?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: OrinTech_pricing_v3.pdf (one-pager), 2026_quarterly_pricing_table.xlsx (workbook)

Subject: Re: Proposal: OrinTech annual renewal + mid-year top-up

Rishi / Monica —

Thanks for the clear options and the workbook. Procurement has reviewed Option 2 (retainer conversion) internally and we prefer the 12-month amortization variant — it fits our monthly forecasting and reduces the spike on the P&L. Please include:

- PO target: PO to Redwood for the retainer + renewal commit by 2026-06-28.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices, net 30.
- PO metadata required: OrinTech PO# (we will issue), Redwood W-9 on file, remit address, and our standard vendor questionnaire (I attached the questionnaire to this reply).

We do have one small ask: can Redwood extend the 10% top-up discount to any additional blocks purchased in month 13 if we provide a 90-day notice? Procurement is concerned about an abrupt price jump at contract anniversary.

If you can confirm that concession, procurement will generate the PO and route for signature.

Regards,
Samir Mehta
Senior Procurement Manager | OrinTech
